parsed.explanation: No trans criminalisation, facility ban, or documented border/police targeting; constitutional court ended sterilisation condition and administrative courts require vulnerability assessment for detained trans foreigners, anti-discrimination law covers gender identity, and hate crimes were prosecuted/sentenced (94/46/42), showing some working recourse. Against this, head-of-state and ministerial transphobia, 71% politician anti-LGBT speech in 2023, and harassment/discrimination highest among trans/nonbinary respondents signal societal hostility. Detention/prison placement remains unprepared, rule-less and inconsistently applied despite supreme-court safeguard, and bias-motivation extension to gender identity is still pending. Cities are rated more open, rural/late-night harassment higher. This is uneven protection amid documented hostility, not unremedied universal exclusion.
